days.title: Days of {price}
days.body: A price may hold on days of its own inside its version (a season's price). Two prices of one style and colourway never hold on the same day.
days.fromHint: Empty: from the version's first day.
days.toHint: Empty: to the version's last day.
days.addHint: Empty: every day of the version.
days.newStart: A new first day writes the price again from that day.
days.newStartBreaks_one: A new first day writes the price again from that day: its own quantity break goes with the old row.
days.newStartBreaks_other: A new first day writes the price again from that day: its {count} own quantity breaks go with the old row.

held.order: The last day comes before the first.
held.overlap: Another price of this style and colourway holds on these days ({from} – {to}).
held.undated: A price of this style and colourway holds every day: give it its own days first.

discount.sub: What the quotes and confirmations of this list's customers print.

breaks.title: Quantity breaks
breaks.sub: From a number of pieces a price gets lower: a price's own break, or a discount on every price of the version.

held.lower: A break lowers the price: under {price}.

surcharges.title: Size surcharges
surcharges.sub: What a size adds to the unit price: an amount or a percent per size, for every style of the version or one style. A style's own surcharges apply where this list sets none.
surcharges.addBody: Each size takes an amount or a percent; a size already set takes the new figure.
surcharges.own: the style's own (kept on the style)
surcharges.emptyBody: Add one: what a size adds to the unit price.
surcharges.how: Type in a cell to change it (saved when you leave it); empty it to remove it. A size takes an amount or a percent: typing one replaces the other.
surcharges.howView: A style's own surcharges are kept on the style.
surcharges.notNumber: Size {size}: "{text}" is not a number. The figure stays as it was.
surcharges.refused: The surcharge was refused: an amount above 0 or a percent from 0 to 100, one per size.

held.size: A size code has at most 40 characters, without spaces.
held.pct: Type a percent above 0 and at most 100.
